GREG, 2026-11-06 about 05:19Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #346, message 1a616fa5). Verbatim: „ok, mozemy zaczac prace nad unifikacja ?”. Asistant's summary of the direction, not his verbatim words: yes, start NOW, in parallel with the ongoing EO trials. The target is ONE owner and ONE implementation of source_id, in Engram, that TermAl and the launchers use: git status plus root commit and submodule pins, with no ls-files or file lists. If it concerns the shared Questly/Phoenix route, take real Flutter/Dart and .NET test results as the outcome, not just exit 0. Don't touch existing evaluations. Coordinate ownership of w-a6c91d6a7f27 and w-24a72c898d6d / w-6f42c416b0c7, don't duplicate work, and report the plan and status.
CONSEQUENCE (Engram::Fable): w-a6c91d6a7f27 is raised to P0 and starts now (owner Engram 12325), no longer "after EO". TermAl's w-24a72c898d6d proceeds in parallel on its shipped rev 5 admission with no new copy, and migrates onto the Engram command when it lands. The launcher run fingerprint (w-0675f3198972, also 12325) is designed as part of the same boundary; its change is presented to Greg with scope and limits before it is made.
